title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Cancellation Terms
content:
**Cancellation.** Only the customer cancels a Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order, and only when the product allows cancellation before submission and the order is still submitted (not yet sent to the biller). Top-ups, data bundles and tokens are sent at once and cannot be cancelled. A cancelled order is refunded in full, fees included, under the refund rules of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay.

Whether the product allows cancellation and whether the order is still submitted are read from Paloma's records of the order — its product and its status.

## The clause in branches

| Product allows cancellation before submission | Order status | Customer may cancel? |
|---|---|---|
| yes (a bill product) | submitted — not yet sent to the biller | yes |
| yes (a bill product) | processing, or any later status — already sent | no |
| no (Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle, Paloma Electricity Token) | any | no |

When the customer cancels, the order's status moves from submitted to cancelled; the payment for the cancelled order is then refunded in full, fees included.

## Basis Q&A

**Who may cancel?** Only the customer. The cancellation is the customer's own act.

**Can a Paloma Electricity Token order be stopped once ordered?** No. Tokens, like top-ups and data bundles, are sent at once and cannot be cancelled.

**A Paloma Bill Pay School Fees payment has already been sent to the biller. Can it be cancelled?** No. Cancellation is possible only while the order is still submitted.

**What does the customer get back on a cancelled bill payment?** The full payment, fees included.
